GROPYUS is using scalable construction and manufacturing solutions to tap into a future market, boost Europe's strength in innovation, while also playing a substantial role in improving sustainability.</p></div><div class="job"> <h3><strong>Über die Position</strong></h3> <p>In dieser Rolle arbeitest du aktiv an der Weiterentwicklung und Standardisierung von operativen Prozessen rund um Planung, Vergabe und Bauausführung im Bereich Systembau und Generalübernehmung. Dein Fokus liegt auf den entscheidenden Übergangsphasen zwischen Planung und Ausführung, insbesondere den Stage Gates SG4 (Ausführungsplanung abgeschlossen) und SG5 (Vergaben &amp; Freeze).&nbsp;</p> <p>Gemeinsam mit Planung, Arbeitsvorbereitung und Projektteams stellst du sicher, dass Projekte mit der notwendigen technischen und organisatorischen Reife in die Bauausführung übergehen. Baustellen zur Validierung und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Prozessen&nbsp;</li> <li>Unterstützung bei der Etablierung und Einhaltung von Prozessstandards im Sinne von Operational Excellence&nbsp;</li> <li>Kontinuierliche Optimierung bestehender Prozesse entlang eines strukturierten Verbesserungsansatzes (z. B. PDCA)&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h3>&nbsp;<strong>Über dich</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bauingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Projektmanagement oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation&nbsp;</li> <li>3–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Bauausführung, Arbeitsvorbereitung, Projektmanagement oder vergleichbaren Funktionen&nbsp;</li> <li>Gutes Verständnis für Ausführungsplanung, Vergaben und Bauabläufe sowie deren Wechselwirkungen&nbsp;</li> <li>Erfahrung in der Analyse, Optimierung oder Standardisierung von Prozessen im Bauumfeld&nbsp;</li> <li>Praxisorientierte Denkweise und Interesse daran, Prozesse im realen Projektumfeld zu verbessern&nbsp;</li> <li>Kommunikationsstärke und Fähigkeit, mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern konstruktiv zusammenzuarbeiten&nbsp;</li> <li>Strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit Fokus auf Qualität und Umsetzbarkeit&nbsp;</li> <li>Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Baustellenbesuchen&nbsp;</li> <li>Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h3>Über uns</h3> <ul> <li>Ein unbefristeter Vertrag mit 30 Urlaubstagen.</li> <li>Flexible Arbeitsweise: Wir legen großen Wert auf regelmäßige persönliche Zusammenarbeit im Büro, und bieten auch die Möglichkeit zum Arbeiten im Homeoffice sowie die Option, bis zu 40 Tage im Jahr aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten.</li> <li>Attraktive Zusatzleistungen: Wir bieten eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Sprachkurse (Englisch/Deutsch) und Mitarbeiterrabatte bei ausgewählten nachhaltigen Marken. Darüber hinaus unterstützen Dich unsere externen Partner im Bereich mentale Gesundheit, um Deine psychische Gesundheit durch anonyme Einzel- oder Gruppensitzungen zu stärken.</li> <li>Virtuelles Aktienprogramm: Profitiere von GROPYUS Erfolg durch unser Virtuelles Aktienprogramm.</li> <li>Eigenverantwortung: Du kannst wirklich etwas bewirken – auf allen Ebenen unserer Organisation. Finde Lösungen, treibe sie voran, teste und implementiere sie.</li> <li>Die Chance, Teil von etwas Großem zu sein: Unsere Mission ist es, eine ganze Branche neu zu denken. Hilf uns dabei, das Bauwesen neu zu erfinden und nachhaltiges, erschwingliches Wohnen zu fördern.</li> <li>Ein vielfältiges und bereicherndes Arbeitsumfeld: Werde ein geschätztes Mitglied eines wunderbar vielfältigen Teams von Menschen aus über 50 Ländern. Bei GROPYUS legen wir großen Wert auf Inklusion und sorgen dafür, dass sich jeder – unabhängig von seinem Hintergrund – als Teil der Gemeinschaft fühlt. So werden unsere Unterschiede zu Stärken, die uns als Team weiterbringen.&nbsp;</li> </ul> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><h4>Join us on our mission to design buildings as continuously evolving products to create the most exciting and affordable experience for all. title: Staff Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Help make the world more hospitable </strong></h4> <p>The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.</p> <p>You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.</p> <p>If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.</p> <h4><strong>About the role</strong></h4> <p>Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:</p></div><p>As Staff Engineer, you'll own the architecture, agents and skills that let every builder in your tribe ship sound, well-architected work without waiting on a handoff, at a moment when Mews has moved almost entirely to an agentic-first engineering model. The problem this role exists to solve is easy to state and hard to do: most technical decisions now get made by builders and the agents they run, not by senior engineers in review, so the standard has to be built into the tooling itself or the gaps show up in what customers touch. Mews is rebuilding hospitality software from the ground up at a genuinely unusual pace, which makes this one of the few staff engineering roles where the leverage you build gets used by everyone around you within weeks.</p> <p>You'll be attached to one tribe, reporting into its Director, and working alongside other staff engineers, staff product managers and staff designers across your division. Your job isn't to ship features. It's to produce the architecture, agents and skills that give every builder in the tribe the context to make sound calls on their own, and to stay hands-on with the hardest problems yourself: the gnarly migrations and system-wide refactors that need an approach invented rather than executed.</p> <p>As Mews moves builders to own a sub-metric end-to-end, with AI covering what they're lighter in, the risk isn't slower shipping, it's the architecture fragmenting underneath the speed. This role exists so the foundations get stronger as the tribe ships faster, not shakier.</p> <h4><strong>What you would do</strong>&nbsp;</h4> <ul> <li>Own the tribe's engineering context, agents and skills, and be accountable for keeping them coherent, current and grounded in real product work</li> <li>Build and evaluate the internal engineering agents and skills that Product Builders use daily, encoding architectural standards, review logic and quality gates directly into the tools they run</li> <li>Extend and improve the tribe's agentic tooling when it isn't good enough yet, since agentic development is the default way you build, not a fallback</li> <li>Stay hands-on with the hardest technical problems: gnarly migrations, system-wide refactors and architecture calls that will shape years of future building</li> <li>When work ships off-bar, trace it back to what was missing in the agents or patterns and fix it at the root so the same class of miss doesn't recur</li> </ul> <p><strong>AI Fluency Level 4:</strong> in this role that means building and shipping the engineering agents and skills that Product Builders rely on every day, not just using AI tools yourself. You need enough understanding of the underlying models and infrastructure to make real engineering decisions about them, because the agents you build become part of the tribe's production system.</p> <p><em>For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to "<a href="https://mews.atlassian.net/wiki/external/YWI5ZGUyMGQ3MjU2NGRmNjlkZGEyYTg2NTVmZGE0OTU">AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates</a>" on Confluence.</em></p> <h4><strong>What you would bring</strong>&nbsp;</h4> <ul> <li>A track record as a senior or staff-level engineer who has shipped and owned complex systems at scale, not just contributed to them</li> <li>Experience turning hard-won technical judgment into reusable architecture, tooling or standards that other engineers actually adopt, rather than documentation that goes unused</li> <li>Comfort holding a multi-cycle technical view (migrations, refactors, architecture decisions that play out over years) while still being able to drop into what needs to ship today</li> <li>Clear communication across levels: builders, your Director, Principals and, when it counts, the C-suite</li> <li>AI Fluency Level 4 or the equivalent hands-on experience: you've shipped something where AI is a core component and can make engineering decisions about the underlying models and infrastructure</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Nice to have</strong>&nbsp;</h4> <ul> <li>Experience in hospitality, travel or another operationally complex B2B SaaS environment</li> <li>A track record of coaching or multiplying other engineers' output, not just your own</li> <li>Public writing or speaking about technical work you've shipped</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Spain</div><div Who We Are:
At Omaze, we give our community in the UK and Germany the chance to win luxury homes and other life-changing prizes — all while raising money for the causes they love.

Thanks to our Omaze Community, we’ve raised over £150 million for UK charities in just five years. That’s millions helping organisations like Age UK, the RSPCA, British Heart Foundation and Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity deliver life-saving work.

And the best part? We’re only just getting started. Omaze is building a business and culture committed to growth and creating significant social impact on a global scale.

🔑 About The Job

Having launched the Million Pound House Draw in 2020, one of the UK’s fastest ever growing products that to date has raised over £150M for charity, Omaze is preparing to build and launch our next big thing. Designed to take our playbook of dream property prizes to new audiences we are seeking a talented and hungry marketeer to help us make it all happen.

Alongside the General Manager you will shape the new proposition and the strategy to bring it to a new audience — defining that audience, positioning the brand and running the creative platform, launching the proposition, and creating a sustainable engine for both brand and commercial growth.

This is a rare opportunity to take something from zero to one and then build the operating rhythm that allows it to grow. You'll start by developing a deep understanding of the customer, defining our positioning and go-to-market strategy, and leading the launch. From there, you'll own the marketing approach for a regular cadence of new campaigns, using customer insight, brand signals and performance data to improve the proposition each time.

You won't have a large dedicated marketing team around you. Instead, you'll need to roll your sleeves up and get it all done, with support from specialists inside and outside of Omaze — including Creative, Performance Marketing, CRM, Brand, PR, Analytics and Product — bringing it all together, delivering a clear strategy and executing brilliantly.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong consumer marketing instincts, brand and creative judgement, commercial thinking and hands-on execution.

🔧 What You’ll Be Doing

Build the go-to-market strategy

  • Develop the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for a new Omaze proposition, from initial customer understanding through launch and scale.

  • Define our priority audiences, their motivations and barriers, and the occasions that will drive participation.

  • Define what this new product should stand for in customers' minds, how it should differentiate itself and how it should relate to the wider Omaze brand and product set.

  • Develop the brand positioning, messaging architecture and creative platform that can build recognition, relevance and desire over time.

  • Determine how the new proposition should relate to the broader Omaze brand and existing product portfolio - including driving incrementality

  • Partner with Product, Commercial, Analytics and Research teams to shape decisions around the customer experience, offer and proposition.

  • Build a clear acquisition and retention strategy, identifying the channels, messages and customer journeys most likely to drive sustainable growth.

  • Translate strategy into measurable objectives, combining brand and commercial KPIs.

Lead every campaign

  • Own the marketing strategy and integrated campaign plan for each new property prize launch.

  • Turn each new campaign into a compelling customer story with a clear audience, insight, proposition and creative brief.

  • Ensure every individual property campaign strengthens the brand as well as delivering its immediate commercial objectives.

  • Set a high creative bar and work closely with Creative teams to develop work that is distinctive, emotionally compelling and capable of building the brand over time.

  • Lead the cross-functional marketing squad responsible for bringing campaigns to market.

  • Partner with Creative, Performance Marketing, CRM, PR, Social and other teams to deliver against the strategy.

  • Ensure every customer touchpoint works together as one coherent campaign, from first impression through conversion and repeat participation.

  • Make clear prioritisation and investment recommendations based on expected commercial impact.

Build the playbook

  • Establish the processes, templates, measurement framework and operating cadence required to run campaigns repeatedly and efficiently.

  • Track and develop our understanding of brand health alongside commercial performance, using measures such as awareness, consideration and customer perceptions where appropriate.

  • Design and prioritise tests across audiences, propositions, messaging, creative, channels and customer journeys.

  • Know when to experiment and optimise, and when consistency and creative conviction are more important than reacting to short-term campaign data.

  • Build a strong understanding of what drives performance by customer segment and campaign type.

  • Turn learnings from each campaign into improvements for the next, creating a compounding growth loop rather than starting from scratch each time.

  • Bring customer insight and market intelligence back into the wider business to help shape the future product roadmap.

We're less interested in a particular industry background than in finding someone who has the right attitude and has shown success at building consumer brands and growing new consumer propositions.

  • Significant experience in consumer marketing, brand, growth or integrated marketing roles.

  • Experience taking a new proposition, product or category from early-stage concept through launch and growth.

  • Experience developing positioning, messaging, customer segmentation and integrated brand and marketing strategies.

  • Strong experimentation instincts and experience using data to improve marketing performance over time, without becoming overly dependent on short-term performance signals..

  • The ability to lead complex cross-functional work without needing direct reporting lines.

  • Excellent briefing and communication skills, particularly with creative and channel specialists.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and building processes where none yet exist.

  • The judgement to know when something needs deep analysis and when it simply needs to get done.

  • 25 days annual leave PLUS Bank Holidays

  • Private medical and dental insurance

  • 9% employer pension contributions, when you contribute at least 2%

  • A generous personal learning and development budget each year to use on training courses, conferences and professional memberships

  • Enhanced family leave policies

  • Life assurance of 4x your salary

We actively seek out diversity of thought and experience to drive innovation. We welcome all backgrounds, identities, and perspectives and work hard to ensure that every Omaze employee can bring their authentic self to work at all times.

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We are looking for Full-Stack Engineers to develop and maintain both front-end and back-end components of our Creative & Studio products. These include the Image/Video, Flows, Agentic Creation, Audiobooks and Music/Studio features.

 Your general responsibilities will include:

  • Building and maintaining our products and platform on top of our cutting-edge voice models, which will be used by millions of users.

  • High degrees of ownership. Developing the product roadmap, and running experiments on some of our enterprise ventures across Creative Platform, Music, and GenAI.

  • Collaborating closely with others on the Engineering, Growth and Sales teams to understand, and design solutions for, our customer and internal team’s most important problems and workflows.

  • Building end-to-end API and Core Engineering workflows for enterprise customers, with potential ML involvement: generative output quality on Image/Video models

We believe in pairing engineers with work that matches their strengths and interests. This means that there is significant flexibility in staffing engineers across the company.

Specific responsibilities might include:  

  • Strong product engineering mindset, able to build 0 > 1 (API through to UI). Scoping and building brand new proof of concept products, sometimes directly with partner customers, that could later be scaled to capture entirely new markets.

  • Improving our existing products to ensure that they’re intuitive, powerful and make innovative use of our research team’s latest break-throughs. This could involve making sweeping architecture changes, adding significant functionality, or building integrations with other common consumer/enterprise solutions.

  • Maintaining and strengthening our internal infrastructure as we scale and grow to ensure that our products remain live, performant and secure.

  • Working to collect, manage, and process massive-scale datasets to lay the groundwork for the next generation of voice models at the forefront of generative AI.

Requirements

We do not require any formal experience, certifications, or degrees. Instead, we are seeking enthusiastic software engineers who can showcase solving impressively hard problems with artifacts such as past projects, designs, or GitHub contributions.

We do require:

  • Expertise in Python

  • Experience with Web Development using Typescript/React

  • Familiarity with common software and system design patterns and infrastructure including APIs, cloud infrastructure tools, storage solutions, data structures etc.

  • Experience designing APIs, platform reliability, and building products at scale

  • Bonus: experience deploying products directly to enterprise customers, or ML/GenAI exposure

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Bangalore, Dublin, London, New York, San Francisco, Tokyo, and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

They help clients understand how marketing organisations, capabilities, ways of working and operating models need to evolve to unlock growth, improve effectiveness and respond to a digitally led, AI-enabled world.</p> <p>This role requires experience in supporting and delivering marketing transformation work. <p><strong>Key&nbsp;Responsibilities:&nbsp;</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Owning discrete workstreams within wider marketing transformation projects, working independently with appropriate oversight and deliverables.</li> <li>Building trusted working relationships with mid-level client teams, confidently facilitating meetings, leading interviews, capturing key insights and helping maintain momentum across project activities.</li> <li>Participating in strategic new business pitches and initiatives, including preparing sections of proposals and identifying add-on opportunities within existing client relationships.</li> <li>Keeping abreast of developments in marketing transformation, modern operating models, organizational change, AI and marketing effectiveness, actively contributing to the team’s knowledge base and thought leadership.</li> <li>Acting as a role model for your grade, supporting Analysts and Consultants, helping onboard new colleagues and contributing to a positive, inclusive and high-performing project environment.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Skills, Attributes and Attitude:</strong></p> <ul> <li>At least 5 years of experience in consulting, client-side strategy, marketing transformation, organizational change or a related field.</li> <li>Emerging specialist expertise in one or more areas of marketing transformation such as operating model design, organizational design, change management, capability building, employee experience, process design or AI-enabled marketing transformation.</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesise quantitative and qualitative inputs, identify key trends and develop clear, actionable recommendations.</li> <li>Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a high-performing team.</li> <li>Understanding of, and interest in, behavioural science and the principles of behaviour change.</li> <li>Able to prepare and lead client interviews, workshops and meetings, using active listening to draw out insight, align stakeholders and move teams toward practical outcomes.</li> <li>Comfort challenging conventional views and presenting ideas persuasively to gain buy-in from clients and colleagues.</li> <li>A strong understanding of modern marketing organisations and how brands, capabilities, technology, data, process and culture come together to drive growth and effectiveness.</li> <li>Curiosity about AI and its impact on marketing transformation, with the ability to identify opportunities to use AI tools and methodologies to improve insight, efficiency and project workflows.</li> <li>Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the energy, pragmatism and flexibility to thrive in a fast-moving consulting environment.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About Ogilvy Consulting</strong></p> <p>Ogilvy Consulting is different from other consultancies: we bridge strategy and execution, rigour and creativity. AIOS is at $400M ARR, growing from $10M/yr 12 months ago. We're the world's fastest growing AI doctor.

We're faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy. We're profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Over the last 12 months we've grown from 3k to 150k UK active GLP-1 patients. We'll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We'll be Europe's largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2031: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We'll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we'll become the world's first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We're a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

Being a Dispenser at Bolt Pharmacy

We are building a world-class team.

As a Dispenser at Bolt Pharmacy (part of AIOS), your fundamental role is to turn prescriptions into treatment patients can count on - safely, accurately and at pace.

You'll be at the heart of our dispensing operation, selecting, labelling and securely packing medicines for patients across the UK. You'll take ownership of your work within your qualified scope, follow dispensing procedures precisely and escalate clinical questions to our pharmacists. Every prescription has a person behind it.

You'll keep quality high as volumes grow. From protecting the cold chain and monitoring storage temperatures to managing stock and checking deliveries, you'll help keep medicines safe and orders moving. You'll report errors and near misses promptly, so we learn quickly and keep improving.

Working alongside pharmacists, fellow dispensers and our stock and customer service teams, you'll help resolve issues before they delay treatment. You'll also support trainee dispensers and spot practical ways to make Bolt Pharmacy's operation more efficient. Your experience will help raise the standard of the whole team.

Great performance means consistently processing 30+ orders per hour while maintaining over 99.5% dispensing accuracy, zero critical errors and full compliance with our procedures. Patients receive the right treatment, colleagues trust your work and we can serve more people with confidence.

This is a full-time, on-site role at Bolt Pharmacy in Blackburn, UK, working standard business hours with possible shift patterns.

You'll report directly to our Shift Lead and work closely with our Site Operations Lead, Michal Binkowski.

You'll work most closely with Bolt Pharmacy's pharmacists, qualified and trainee dispensers, Stock Control and Customer Service, combining dispensing oversight, shared workloads and patient support.

Key responsibilities

  • Get every prescription right: Select, label and prepare medicines accurately within your qualified scope, following SOPs and escalating clinical queries to pharmacists.

  • Keep treatment moving: Process and securely pack 30+ orders per hour while maintaining accuracy, safety and compliance.

  • Protect every medicine: Maintain cold-chain controls, monitor fridge and room temperatures, and escalate storage deviations immediately.

  • Take ownership of stock: Check incoming deliveries, maintain correct storage and rotation, and support stock takes so medicines are available when needed.

  • Make quality everyone's business: Record errors, near misses and incidents promptly, keep workstations clean and compliant, follow hygiene and PPE procedures, and suggest practical improvements.

  • Raise the team's standard: Guide trainee dispensers, support colleagues and work with Customer Service to resolve patient queries and order updates.

Need to have

  • Dispensing qualification: You hold a valid Buttercups certification or equivalent dispensing qualification.

  • Experience at pace: You've worked in high-volume dispensing and can consistently meet a target of 30+ orders per hour without compromising safety.

  • Attention to detail: You bring exceptional accuracy to medicine selection, labelling and prescription preparation.

  • Ownership within your scope: You organise your workload independently, follow SOPs precisely and know when to involve a pharmacist.

  • Professionalism: You're reliable, punctual and committed to patient safety and regulatory compliance.

Nice to have

  • Qualified experience: You've spent at least a year working as a qualified dispenser.

  • Online pharmacy: You understand the demands of dispensing and dispatching treatment to patients remotely.

  • Mentoring: You've trained or supported junior colleagues and can explain procedures clearly.

  • Stock management: You bring experience in inventory control, stock rotation and keeping a busy dispensary supplied.

  • Patient support: You've handled healthcare queries with care, clarity and professionalism.

  • Pharmacy standards: You're familiar with GPhC requirements and how they translate into everyday practice.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come — it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully — in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status — we ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.

🎯 "You just build a f*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."

Compensation & Benefits

Our compensation package includes equity, giving you the opportunity to share in what we build.

  • Training role: £13 per hour while you complete the required training and sign-off.

  • Qualified role: £15 per hour in total compensation, including equity, once you have completed the required training and are qualified and signed off for the role.

Benefits

The stuff below is cool as well.

  • Personal development: A £400 budget for books, courses and coaching to keep building your skills.

  • Personal wellness: A £400 budget for the gym and health apps to support your wellbeing.

  • GLP-1s: Get free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s, if clinically applicable.

  • Health coaching: Access free biweekly health coaching to help you stay healthy.

  • Work coaching: Access free biweekly work coaching to stay sharp and calm.

  • What are we missing? We're still early, so your ideas can help shape our culture.

As Senior Product Manager, Fisheries, you will own the Fisheries product end to end, from strategy and roadmap through to first release and go-to-market. Working closely with the Lead Product Manager – Maritime & Logistics, you will build a new product offering that brings together Kpler's vessel, ownership, port, and trade-flow data to address growing challenges around seafood supply chain transparency and illegal, unreported and unregulated (IUU) fishing.

Your initial focus will be on building live fleet monitoring and catch and yield reporting, enabling procurement and compliance teams to monitor vessels, understand fishing activity, and access reliable information to support their due-diligence and traceability requirements.

This is a high-impact opportunity to build a new product category from the ground up. You will work directly with seafood buyers, retailers, processors, certification bodies, regulators, RFMO stakeholders, and NGOs, as well as Product, Engineering, Data, Sales, and Marketing teams, to ensure the product delivers trusted and actionable intelligence.

The role is ideal for an experienced product leader who is comfortable operating in an ambiguous, early-stage environment and has a track record of taking B2B data, analytics, or SaaS products from concept through to customer adoption.




Key Responsibilities
  • Own the Fisheries product strategy, vision, and roadmap, defining what gets built and in what order while balancing customer value, commercial opportunity, technical feasibility, and time to market.
  • Lead the development and delivery of the first Fisheries product release, focused on live fleet monitoring and subsequently catch and yield reporting that procurement and compliance teams can rely on.
  • Lead market and customer discovery with seafood buyers, retailers, processors, certification bodies, regulators, RFMO stakeholders, and NGOs to understand customer needs and translate insights into product direction.
  • Define and refine the product proposition and customer experience, ensuring Kpler's data and intelligence are translated into clear, actionable outcomes for customers across the seafood supply chain.
  • Establish the vessel identity, dark-behaviour, and catch-estimation methodologies underpinning the product, working with data and domain experts to ensure the outputs are credible, transparent, and trusted.
  • Own positioning and competitive strategy, monitoring the existing commercial and NGO-adjacent landscape and clearly defining Kpler's differentiation.
  • Lead the go-to-market strategy for the product, working with Sales and Product Marketing on positioning, messaging, packaging, pricing input, launch planning, and early customer adoption.
  • Identify and develop strategic partnerships across the seafood supply chain, including data, certification, and distribution partnerships that can strengthen the product and accelerate adoption.
  • Act as the key link between Product, Engineering, Data, Sales, and Marketing, creating alignment around product strategy, priorities, launch plans, and customer outcomes.
  • Track product performance, customer feedback, delivery progress, and key risks, using evidence and market insight to continuously refine the roadmap and maximise product impact.

    • Skills and Responsibilities
  • 5–7 years of Product Management or senior commercial experience, ideally within maritime data, seafood supply chains, or a related B2B data/SaaS environment.
  • Proven track record of owning products end-to-end, from strategy and customer discovery through to delivery, launch, and customer adoption.
  • Strong track record of translating complex customer needs into clear product strategy, roadmap priorities, and product requirements, working closely with Product and Engineering teams.
  • Strong understanding of the fisheries data landscape, including vessel tracking, IUU risk, catch documentation, and supply chain traceability.
  • Experience operating in ambiguous, early-stage environments, with a pragmatic and iterative approach to building, launching, learning, and improving products.
  • Strong commercial and go-to-market experience, including product positioning, packaging, pricing input, launch planning, and working closely with Sales and Marketing.
  • Strong data and analytical literacy, with the ability to work effectively with data and engineering teams and understand maritime and trade data concepts such as AIS, vessel identity, geospatial analysis, ownership, and flows.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships across technical, commercial, regulatory, and NGO audiences.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate clearly with senior external stakeholders.
  • Strong ownership mindset and a bias to action, with the confidence to make decisions, navigate uncertainty, and focus on delivering outcomes rather than perfection.

    • Nice to have
  • Direct experience within the fisheries or seafood sector, particularly procurement, traceability, or certification.
  • Experience building and launching a new product line rather than managing an established product.
  • An established network across seafood buyers, certification bodies, regulators, or fisheries NGOs.
  • Understanding of relevant fisheries regulations, including IUU regulations, US SIMP, or the EU carding system.

title: Senior Electrical Characterisation Engineer
description: About The Role and Team Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing scale-up based in London founded by internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University with over 40 years’ experience in developing qubits and quantum computing architectures. Bringing together state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities and an outstanding interdisciplinary team, we are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence and more. Our Team Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times in 2021 and 2022, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph , BBC and the New Statesman . Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million. We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology. This is a rare and exciting opportunity to be an employee at a scale-up shaping the future of quantum computing. There are vast opportunities for professional growth and to make an impact within the company. Our team of 100+ is based across London, Oxford, San Sebastián and Sydney, with our primary hub in Islington (London). We are looking for a Senior Electrical Characterisation Engineer to join our Process Integration team and play a key role in understanding, qualifying and improving the silicon devices at the heart of our quantum processors. You will sit at a fascinating intersection between semiconductor manufacturing and quantum hardware, working closely with foundries, process engineers and quantum engineers. You will use electrical characterisation and large-scale data analysis to understand manufacturing variability, identify the root causes of device behaviour, and feed those insights directly back into the semiconductor fabrication process. This is an opportunity to have a tangible impact on the yield, quality and scalability of quantum processors, working with some of the most advanced silicon technology being developed for quantum computing. Our Team

Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. There are three key teams within WPP Media Analytics UK:</p> <ol> <li><strong>Modelling Services team</strong> – this is the largest part of the team and is responsible for all of our modelling work, including MMM, brand health modelling, RBA and other bespoke modelling solutions. Content Creation</strong></span></h3> <ul> <li style="font-size: 14pt;"><span style="font-size: 14pt;">Build, launch, and maintain a world-class MSP enablement toolkit, including pitch decks, battlecards, data sheets, and value-proposition messaging frameworks.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 14pt;"><span style="font-size: 14pt;">Collaborate with Product Marketing to translate complex technical features into business outcomes that align with an MSP’s business model (e.g., recurring revenue, operational efficiency).</span></li> <li style="font-size: 14pt;"><span style="font-size: 14pt;">Own the marketing content strategy for the Partner Portal, ensuring assets are localized, up-to-date, and intuitive.</span></li> </ul> <h3><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration &amp; Optimization</strong></span></h3> <ul> <li style="font-size: 14pt;"><span style="font-size: 14pt;">Establish, track, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) such as partner In quarter created pipeline contribution (IQC), marketing-generated leads (MQLs), Marketing Influenced Pipeline (MIP), partner portal engagement, and program ROI.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 14pt;"><span style="font-size: 14pt;">Continually optimize campaign performance based on data insights, partner feedback, and regional sales inputs.</span></li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong>WHAT YOU BRING</strong></span></h2> <ul> <li style="font-size: 14pt;"><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong>Domain Expertise:</strong> At least 6+ years of dedicated MSP Marketing experience. A deep understanding of how MSPs or MSSPs operate, package, and price services is essential.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 14pt;"><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong>Experience:</strong> 6+ years of B2B MSP marketing experience within the&nbsp; high-tech or software industry (SaaS, Cybersecurity, or Cloud infrastructure preferred).</span></li> <li style="font-size: 14pt;"><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong>Global Scale:</strong> Proven track record of creating centralized marketing programs that successfully scale across multiple global regions.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 14pt;"><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong>Content &amp; Messaging:</strong> Exceptional writing and communication skills, with a proven ability to distill complex technical platforms into a clear "Why [Company Name] for MSPs" value proposition.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 14pt;"><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong>MarTech Proficiency:</strong> Hands-on experience with CRM and Marketing Automation tools (e.g., Salesforce, Marketo, AppSheet) and Partner Relationship Management (PRM) platforms.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 14pt;"><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong>Education:</strong> Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).</span></li> <li style="font-size: 14pt;"><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong>The "Channel First" Mindset:</strong> An inherent understanding that your success is completely tied to the success and ease of use for your partners.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 14pt;"><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong>Agility &amp; description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>Who we are</h3> <p>Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.</p></div><p><span class="s1" style="font-size: 14pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Typeform is fully remote by design. For this role, we can hire candidates based in the UK, Ireland, Germany, Portugal, Spain or The Netherlands</span></span><strong><span class="s1" style="font-size: 14pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><br></span></span><br>About the role</strong></p> <p>We’re looking for a <strong>Senior FP&amp;A Analyst</strong> to join our Finance team and help drive clarity through data. This is a <strong>hands-on, individual contributor role</strong> with a strong focus on analysis and execution.</p> <p>This is not a traditional finance business partner or governance role. Instead, you’ll spend most of your time working directly with data, building models, analyzing performance, and translating complex signals into clear, actionable insights for Product, Growth, and description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Anthropic</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.</p></div><h2><strong>About Anthropic</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.</p> <h2><strong>About Beneficial Deployments</strong></h2> <p>Beneficial Deployments ensures AI reaches and benefits the communities that need it most. We partner with nonprofits, foundations, and mission-driven organizations to deploy Claude in education, global health, economic mobility, and life sciences, focusing on raising the floor.</p> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>We're looking for an Applied AI Architect to join Beneficial Deployments, focused on maximizing the impact of Claude in the life sciences. Our goal is ambitious: accelerate scientific progress from R&amp;D through translation by an order of magnitude. That means making Claude the go-to tool for the life sciences ecosystem, from early discovery in academia to paradigm-shifting biotech to reimagining pharma pipelines.</p> <p>This role combines technical expertise with deep relationship-building. You'll be the primary technical advisor for our life sciences partners, including flagship research institutions like The Howard Hughes Medical Institute (HHMI) and The Allen Institute. You'll drive engagements from discovery through deployment, working closely with the life sciences segment lead and Applied AI Engineers to deliver impact. This role will be part of the founding Beneficial Deployments Applied AI team focused on bringing life sciences closer to the frontier.</p> <h2><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Serve as the primary technical advisor to life sciences research institutions and mission-driven organizations throughout their Claude adoption journey. Partner with the segment lead to understand scientific workflows end-to-end and translate them into impactful solutions from discovery through deployment.</li> <li>Transform partners into AI-native organizations through Claude Code and Claude Science enablements and research and business process evolution, so they can operate more effectively and build for where AI capabilities are headed.</li> <li>Design and lead cohort-based accelerators to scale our expertise and impact across multiple institutions at once.<br>Identify what's actually hard about deploying AI in life sciences and feed those findings back to product, engineering, and research.</li> <li>Spot patterns across partners to inform what we build at the ecosystem level, including MCP servers for domain-specific data sources, scientifically grounded benchmarks and evals, and reusable agent skills.</li> <li>Create technical presentations, demos, and scalable content (documentation, tutorials, sample code) so what works for one institution can scale globally without the same level of hand-holding.</li> <li>Travel occasionally to partner sites for workshops, technical deep dives, and relationship building.</li> <li>Help shape team processes and culture as we scale from 1 to N.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You Might Be a Good Fit If You Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>8+ years in a technical role, ideally with customer-facing exposure (Solutions Architect, Customer Engineer, Sales Engineer, Technical Account Manager, Product Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer)</li> <li>Experience in life sciences, biomedical research, or scientific computing. Bonus if you've worked in genomics, neuroscience, or drug discovery specifically and are comfortable getting deeply technical with academics.</li> <li>Experience working in or building trust with academic research institutions, biotech, pharma, or other mission-driven scientific organizations, and an understanding of their unique challenges and constraints</li> <li>Familiarity with common LLM implementation patterns, including prompt and context engineering, evaluation frameworks, agent architectures, and retrieval frameworks</li> <li>A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed</li> <li>A scrappy mentality: comfortable wearing multiple hats, building from scratch, driving clarity in ambiguous situations, and doing whatever it takes to further the mission</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.&nbsp;</p> <p>For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.</p></div><div class="title">Annual Salary:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£165,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>£190,000 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Logistics</strong></h2> <p><strong>Minimum education: </strong>Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience</p> <p><strong>Required field of study:&nbsp;</strong>A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience</p> <p><strong>Minimum years of experience: </strong>Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position</p> <p><strong>Location-based hybrid policy:</strong> Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.</p> <p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Visa sponsorship:</strong>&nbsp;We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.</p> <p><strong>We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.</strong> Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.&nbsp; Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.<br><br><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Your safety matters to us.</strong> To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit&nbsp;<u data-stringify-type="underline"><a class="c-link c-link--underline" href="http://anthropic.com/careers" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="http://anthropic.com/careers" data-sk="tooltip_parent" data-remove-tab-index="true">anthropic.com/careers</a></u>&nbsp;directly for confirmed position openings.</p> <h2><strong>How we're different</strong></h2> <p>We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.</p> <p>The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI &amp; Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.</p> <h2><strong>Come work with us!</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. <strong data-stringify-type="bold">Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:</strong>&nbsp;Learn about&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="https://www.anthropic.com/candidate-ai-guidance" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.anthropic.com/candidate-ai-guidance" data-sk="tooltip_parent">our policy</a> for using AI in our application process.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">About Wolt</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.<br><br>Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.</span></p></div><h2><strong>About the Team</strong></h2> <p>The Core BI team at DoorDash builds and operates the services, integrations and automation that power business intelligence across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt. BI is the domain you serve (primarily Looker and Sigma, and the systems around them), but the problems are backend and platform problems.</p> <p>You will own problems from discovery through design, implementation, deployment, and operational support. because you will…</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Design, build, test, deploy and operate the backend services, APIs and automation that the BI platforms across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt depend on</li> <li>Automate the platform lifecycle end to end (provisioning, metadata, permissions, migrations, archival and validation) so administration stops being manual work</li> <li>Build the integrations between BI platforms and the wider ecosystem: warehouses, identity providers, orchestration, CI/CD and internal developer tooling</li> <li>Improve the availability, observability, performance, scalability and security of the systems you own, and carry them in production</li> <li>Use AI tooling as part of how you engineer, and where it fits, build LLM-backed capabilities held to the same developer experience for everyone building on the platform</li> </ul> <h2><strong>We’re excited about you because…</strong></h2> <ul> <li>3+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production backend, platform or infrastructure systems</li> <li>Readable, maintainable, well-tested code in Python, plus comfort with SQL and a working understanding of data modelling and warehousing concepts</li> <li>Experience building and owning APIs, integrations or automation in production, with sound judgement on service boundaries, authentication, data contracts and failure modes</li> <li>Hands-on with CI/CD, containers and Kubernetes, observability, debugging and incident response, and you expect to operate what you build</li> <li>Hands-on experience using AI tools (LLMs, agentic workflows, AI-assisted development) as part of how you engineer, and judgement about where they help and where they do not</li> <li>End-to-end ownership of ambiguous problems, clear communication with technical and non-technical teams, and comfort self-organising in a fast-paced, distributed environment</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience Okta, SCIM or role-based access controls, or building multi-tenant platforms across brands and regions</li> <li>Experience shipping LLM-backed features to real users (retrieval, grounding and evaluation), or with MCP, agent frameworks or tool-calling in production</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">Our Commitment to description: <div class="content-intro"><p><a href="https://fin.ai/">Fin</a> is the AI Customer Agent company on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.</p> <p>Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey – from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk for one single system that is designed to meet the needs of modern day support teams.</p> <p>Founded in 2011, Fin became one of the fastest growing companies and remains one of the largest private software companies in the world with nearly 30,000 global businesses using our products to transform their customer support. Driven by our core values, we push boundaries, build with speed and intensity, and relentlessly deliver incredible value to our customers.</p></div><h2>What's the opportunity?&nbsp;</h2> <p>We’re seeking a transformational Solutions Engineering leader to lead our SE team within the EMEA region. You’ll be a pivotal figure in helping Intercom scale its AI-driven support platform to some of the world’s most well-known brands. This role will shape how we engage with large, complex organizations, defining our go-to-market, building a world-class team, and delivering tangible customer outcomes through innovation and credibility.</p> <p>This role is both strategic and hands-on. You will lead a Solutions Engineering team focused on winning complex deals, creating vertical-specific solution architectures, and building repeatable playbooks. We believe in leaders who are open to be a player and a coach, regardless of seniority. You’ll collaborate closely with Sales, Success, Product, Engineering, and Services to deliver customer transformation through Intercom’s AI-first platform – be it through strategic guidance as a senior leader on the team, or securing deals with your own technical credibility where needed.</p> <h2>What will I be doing?&nbsp;</h2> <ul> <li>Define and evolve the strategic vision and go-to-market (GTM) approach for the Solutions Engineering function.</li> <li>Lead, coach, and scale a high-performing SE team across global regions and core verticals.</li> <li>Operate as a player-coach, actively engaging in strategic deals while developing team capabilities.</li> <li>Support complex, six-figure sales cycles with technical guidance, architecture, demos, and product evaluation support, as well as sales expertise.</li> <li>Serve as a trusted technical advisor and executive point of contact for large customers.</li> <li>Partner closely with Sales, Product, Marketing, and R&amp;D to shape verticalized GTM motions and solution strategy.</li> <li>Champion a customer-obsessed culture across the pre-sales journey – from outbound to implementation.</li> <li>Lead discovery, design, and delivery of tailored technical solutions, including PoCs and business value assessments.</li> <li>Build reusable, scalable solution frameworks, and industry-specific technical assets.</li> <li>Advocate for customer needs and insights internally to influence product roadmap and prioritization.</li> <li>Represent Intercom and the SE function externally through executive meetings and strategic events.</li> <li>Foster strong relationships with C-level stakeholders, translating AI product capabilities into tangible business impact.</li> </ul> <h2>What skills do I need?&nbsp;</h2> <ul> <li>5+ years of pre-sales experience as a Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer/Architect, or related individual contributor role.</li> <li>Having 3+ years of experience leading technical pre-sales teams, with a proven track record of hiring, mentoring, and managing high-performing teams.</li> <li>Ideally, experience selling AI, data, or highly technical products; or at the very least, deep curiosity and utilization of AI on your day-to-day.</li> <li>Comfortable with ambiguity in environments with an ability to stay focused and thrive under pressure while working with customers to solve their most challenging issues.</li> <li>Have a humble attitude, and a passion to help others, with a willingness to learn whatever it takes to support the team and help our customers thrive.</li> <li>A track record of consistently delivering revenue numbers, producing accurate forecasts, while maintaining a focus on team development and growth</li> <li>Able to travel internationally on average once a month</li> <li>Ability to flex working hours to partner with teams in US and APAC.</li> <li>Excellent communication and presentation skills</li> </ul> <p>#LI-Hybrid</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements.<br><br>Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at <span><a href="http://fin.ai/careers" target="_blank">fin.ai/careers</a></span>.</p> <p><strong>Policies&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.</p> <p>We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our&nbsp;<a href="https://www.intercom.com/careers">core values</a>.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>Fin values diversity and is committed to a policy of Equal Employment Opportunity. Fin will not discriminate against an applicant or employee on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, age, physical or mental disability, veteran or military status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state, or local law.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

raw.description:
Role: Head of Data Engineering

Location: Manchester based office – Hybrid working

Package: £90k OTE

 

PHMG is continuing to develop and mature its data capability, focusing on modernising our data platform and enhancing the way we work. This creates further opportunities to leverage data more effectively, allowing us to better serve our customers and colleagues. As part of this continued development, we are looking to strengthen our Data Engineering capability and maximise the value from the wealth of data held across the organisation. 

To support this vision, we are seeking a Head of Data Engineering. This pivotal role will lead an established Data Engineering team, supporting their development while strengthening engineering practices, technical standards and ways of working across the function. The successful candidate will foster a culture of technical excellence, collaboration and continuous improvement. 

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced data engineering leader to help develop our data engineering community of practice, define data standards across the organisation and be part of the team delivering and evolving PHMG's Data Strategy. 

The role: What you will do: 

  • Lead, manage and develop the Data Engineering team, building capability, resilience and strong ways of working.
  • Own PHMG's core data platform, architecture, data warehouse and associated pipelines, ensuring solutions are scalable, reliable, maintainable and cost-effective.
  • Own Data Engineering delivery, ensuring work is appropriately designed, prioritised and delivered to agreed standards.
  • Establish and embed strong engineering practices across source control, CI/CD, testing, code review, documentation, monitoring and error handling.
  • Work closely with the wider Data team to translate the Data Strategy and business priorities into an effective engineering roadmap and delivery plan.
  • Work closely with IT, Infrastructure and other engineering teams on architecture, integrations, migrations and platform decisions.
  • Identify and evaluate opportunities to improve the performance, reliability and efficiency of PHMG's data capability, including the use of emerging technologies.

This is an exciting role for an experienced data engineering leader who has: 

  • Demonstrable experience leading, developing and managing Data Engineering teams.
  • A strong track record of designing and delivering enterprise-scale data platforms, solutions and architectures.
  • A thorough understanding of modern ETL/ELT practices and experience designing scalable, reliable and maintainable data pipelines.
  • Advanced working knowledge of SQL and Python.
  • Experience working with modern cloud data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift or BigQuery. Experience within the Microsoft data ecosystem would be advantageous.
  • Strong understanding of modern engineering practices including source control, CI/CD, automated testing, code review, monitoring and observability.
  • Strong experience of data modelling for reporting and analytics, using tools and approaches such as dbt or equivalent.
  • Strong understanding of data quality, governance, security and data management best practices.
  • Experience managing engineering delivery using agile ways of working.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions, risks and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Nice to have experience: 

  • Experience integrating data with operational systems, including reverse ETL into platforms such as Salesforce.
  • Understanding of the Data Science / Machine Learning lifecycle and MLOps.
  • Experience using Infrastructure as Code approaches and tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.

Why PHMG Tech:  

The IT, Development and Data functions within PHMG continue to evolve how we use technology and data to deliver value to the business. We want to build an open, collaborative culture where people communicate honestly, support each other and take pride in delivering good work. 

About PHMG: 

Established in 1998, PHMG has grown from a renowned Manchester-based business to the world's leading audio branding agency – working with 36,000 clients in 54 countries across the globe. This expansive client list includes household names of the calibre of Samsung, Audi and Adidas, as well as SMEs in every sector of the global market. We give each of them a stellar production that combines creative copy, world-class voice artistry and an exclusive Brand-Sound-Track™ – strengthening their business identity in the most memorable, emotive way.

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.</strong></p> <p>Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.</p> <p>Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.</p> <p>As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.</p> <p>We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.</p> <p>Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role:&nbsp;&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Based in London, the Director NATO &amp; Nordics will be responsible for leading our regional sales organization, driving Planet’s Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy, and accelerating revenue growth across national security, defense, and government sectors.</p> <p>As a people manager and business leader, you will own the regional revenue target, drive executive alignment, and establish disciplined pipeline governance to ensure forecast predictability. You will be responsible for building, mentoring, and coaching a team of direct reports—fostering a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous professional development. In addition to team development, you will architect large-scale strategic programs, lead high-stakes commercial negotiations, and scale partner ecosystems to penetrate priority markets. Above all, you will leverage your leadership experience to elevate Planet’s market presence across NATO and the Nordics in alignment with our mission to see change and change the world.</p> <p>The ideal candidate is an accomplished sales leader with deep defense domain expertise and a track record of managing high-performing teams across Alliance structures and Northern European markets. You will bring an established executive network spanning NATO HQ, allied Defense Ministries, Armed Forces Commands, Intelligence Agencies, and key European Prime Contractors/System Integrators. Combining strategic commercial acumen with an understanding of collective defense and national security priorities, you will position Planet as a trusted capability provider for mission-critical operations.</p> <p>This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our London office 3 days per week.</p> <p><strong>Impact You’ll Own:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Drive Strategic Revenue Growth: Own and execute a result-oriented Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy to build, negotiate, and close high-value, complex deals across sovereign defense and government sectors, consistently hitting or exceeding regional quota targets.</li> <li>Forecast Governance &amp; Predictability: Maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene (Salesforce.com) and deliver accurate, data-driven revenue forecasts to executive leadership through disciplined deal inspection and pipeline management.</li> <li>Capture Strategy &amp; Value Messaging: Engineer tailored capture strategies and high-impact executive narratives that align with agency-level priorities, resonate with key decision-makers, and win competitive procurements.</li> <li>Manage, Coach &amp; Empower: Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing sales team, establishing a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous professional development.</li> <li>Methodology Alignment: Train and inspect direct reports on core sales methodologies and capture frameworks (e.g., MEDDPICC, Shipley), coaching them on deal qualification, stakeholder mapping, and win strategies.</li> <li>Talent Bench &amp; Scaling: Proactively recruit, onboard, and retain elite commercial and defense-domain talent to build a solid talent bench as the regional footprint expands.</li> <li>Cross-Functional Matrix Alignment: Orchestrate seamless collaboration across internal matrix teams including Government Affairs, Product, Engineering, and Field Marketing to align corporate capabilities with regional market opportunities.</li> <li>Technical &amp;
